build_instance_segmentation_predictions: build instance segmentation predictions from MaskFormer model outputs using post_process_instance_segmentation
create_binary_masks_from_segmentation: create binary masks from segmentation maps using convert_segmentation_map_to_binary_masks with optional label reduction
run_panoptic_segmentation: run panoptic segmentation post-processing on MaskFormer outputs with label fusion and overlap thresholding
convert_masks_to_rle: convert binary masks to run-length encoding format using binary_mask_to_rle
filter_low_confidence_masks: filter out low-confidence masks and no-object queries from MaskFormer predictions using remove_low_and_no_objects
